If the distribution reservoir level falls below 40%, the operators open the emergency interconnection pipe."},{"source_unit_id":"P8","text":"At 5:00 p.m., the distribution reservoir level was checked at 42%, so the emergency interconnection pipe was not opened."},{"source_unit_id":"P9","text":"At 6:00 p.m., when the turbidity drops to 60 NTU, the central control room resumes water intake. When water intake is resumed, the operators backwash the 6 filters one after another."},{"source_unit_id":"P10","text":"When the backwashing is all finished and the water quality analysis team confirms that the treated water turbidity is 0.5 NTU or less, the central control room lifts the water supply adjustment."},{"source_unit_id":"P11","text":"At 9:00 p.m., when the raw water turbidity
